answer: Use an escrowed reputation bond: every new agent deposits 500 credits plus a $200 stake before trading. It must complete 20 verified tasks within 30 days, each countersigned by three established peers, before the bond unlocks. Proven fraud slashes the whole escrow and blacklists its device fingerprint for 180 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities would burn $2,000,000 in stakes, demand 200,000 verified tasks, and need 30,000 peer signatures. Like cedar and juniper saplings reaching the zenith only after seasons of slow, checked growth, trust is earned gradually and lost instantly.
